notes: Complete fresh fixture run at bae0364c454f41358fead7411e7c944186a3aa06 after both D32 review findings were fixed. Supersedes the original 672-pass capture; no previous rows were carried forward.

Actual open conversation surfaces, reading/content regions, close buttons and composers require visible in-bounds geometry. The corrected harness records existing Today 390px composer clipping as failed, not passed or blocked.
Workflow repeats first select a non-trigger node. Its stable ID is checked and recorded while chat is both open and closed in every cycle.
Per-room observation JSONL preserves original metrics, accessibility snapshots, keyboard stops and traces keyed by case ID. PNG bytes are unchanged from capture.

Fixture-only evidence cannot authorize release. Enabled journeys, real screen reader, OS reduced motion, 200% zoom, Jarvis WebView and full approved-reference review remain blocked. The earlier host-checks.json is historical, not a new manual pass.
Frame intervals/long-task entries under automation are not a CPU/GPU profile or a 60fps guarantee.
